podcast.body: This album is considered the first Celtic rock album. Its title is derived from a traditional Irish jig. It was recorded using the Rolling Stones' mobile truck, which had just been used by The Rolling Stones for "Exile on Main Street" in France and was later used by Deep Purple for "Smoke on the Water" in Switzerland. "The first album was called Happy to Meet, Sorry to Part, from 1972. This title comes from that of a traditional Irish jig. It was recorded with a Rolling Stones mobile truck, just after the Stones used it to make exile on Main Street in France, and not long after D-Purple used it to record smoke on the water in Switzerland."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
